# MatrixQR Digital Menu Generator

> Free, secure, client-side online tool that converts physical menu images into scannable digital QR codes for restaurants, cafes, and bars.

## Core Features

- [Instant Image-to-QR](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Convert JPG, PNG, or WEBP menu images (up to 10MB) into scannable QR codes instantly.
- [Privacy & Security](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Menu images securely stored in cloud storage; no user-identifiable data collected or shared.
- [Free & Frictionless](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Unlimited usage with no user registration, payment, or account creation required.
- [Mobile Friendly](https://menu.matrixqr.cc/): Optimized for quick scanning and seamless display on iOS and Android devices.
